title: Quantization Impact Evaluation Pipeline + Adaptive Threshold Tuning
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an automated evaluation pipeline to measure quality regressions and latency/cost trade-offs when applying quantization profiles (int8, int4) using AWQ and GPTQ variants. The goal is to make per-model and per-workload decisions deterministic: identify safe quant configs, surface regressions tied to config changes, and automatically tune thresholds used by rollout policies.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Daily automated job runs full matrix of selected models x quant backends (AWQ/GPTQ) x profiles (int8, int4, per-layer variants) and produces a CSV of metrics in S3.
2) Regression detector flags any config causing >=1.5% relative drop on primary metric or >=0.5% absolute increase in hallucination rate.
3) Threshold tuning component suggests profile-specific tolerances and stores them in config service.
4) Canary rollout workflow uses these thresholds to allow safe promotion of quantized variants with automatic rollback on production telemetry.
5) Documentation and runbook updated; at least one demo canary executed in staging with observable rollback behavior.
metrics_of_interest: primary_metric=ROUGE-L (summarization) / ExactMatch (QA); secondary_metrics=Token-F1, HallucinationRate, Perplexity, Latency-P50/P95, Cost-per-token
datasets_and_slices: redwood-eval-suite-v2 (2K prompts), production-prompt-sample-100k (stratified by customer vertical), llmbench-safety-50, summarization-core-2k (sensitive to paraphrase quality)
eval_matrix: models=[rw-7b, rw-13b, open-mpt-30b]; backends=[AWQ,GPTQ]; quant_levels=[int8,int4]; per_layer_variants=[baseline, atten-scaled, kv-only]; seq_lengths=[128,512,2048]
tuning_strategy: Start with grid runs for each model x backend x quant_level to compute delta against fp16 baseline. If multiple configs meet delta thresholds, run Bayesian search over per-layer scale multipliers and weight grouping to optimize latency-cost while staying within quality bounds.
regression_rules: Trigger if relative drop >= 1.5% on primary metric OR absolute hallucination rate increase >= 0.5 percentage points. For high-sensitivity workloads (financial/legal labels), use thresholds 50% tighter.
alerting_and_rollout: Automated alerts to #inference-regressions Slack with severity (info/warning/critical). Canary rollout policy: staging 100% -> prod canary 1% (48h) -> 10% (48h) -> 50% (72h) -> full. Rollback if production telemetry violates threshold for two consecutive collection windows.
data_retention_and_artifacts: All eval outputs written to s3://redwood-quant-evals/{date}/ with summary CSV and per-example diffs. Dashboards in Grafana: dashboard 'Quant-Evals' and 'Canary-Guardrails'. PRs and design docs linked below.
implementation_notes: Prototype runner implemented in evals-service (Python + Ray). Current bottleneck: GPU packing efficiency when running int4 AWQ kernels; observed 8% variance in latency p95 across runs. We're instrumenting per-batch kernel selection logs and adding deterministic seed control for weight-quant RNGs.
current_blockers:
1) Missing AWQ quantized weights for rw-13b in S3 (request made to model-ops).
2) TPU/GPU instance heterogeneity causing noisy latency baselines; need standardized ci-gpu instance type.
3) Need engineering time to wire threshold storage into config service (config-api ticket queued).
next_steps: 1) Complete AWQ weight ingestion (assigned model-ops). 2) Finish Bayesian tuner prototype and run on rw-7b/awq-int8. 3) Create Grafana alert rules and Slack integration. 4) Schedule staging canary and demo on 2025-03-18.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Too-aggressive thresholds block beneficial quant profiles leading to increased cost. Mitigation: Provide manual override and allow per-customer opt-in. Risk: Noisy baselines causing false positives. Mitigation: Normalize by instance type and require two consecutive windows before action.
notes: Keep outputs human-readable; include per-example diffs with golden responses where possible.
Prioritize rw-7b then rw-13b; defer 30b family until kernel stability improves.
Coordinate with Console team to expose canary status and simple rewind controls for SREs.
